KELLOW CONSTRUCTION · DESIGN-BUILD · SANTA BARBARA, CA
Santa Barbara Home Remodeling and Renovation

Kellow Construction is a licensed general contractor in Santa Barbara, specializing in home renovation and the design-build process. As a design build firm, we’re a full service team for the entire project. We have architectural design, interior design Santa Barbara homeowners trust, planning, permitting, and construction. Our model has proven time and again that there is real power, efficiency, and a overall better client experience in having the designers and the builders all on the same team.

High-Touch, Small-Team Experience on Large Projects: Big enough and experienced to handle complex, high-end projects.

Small enough that homeowners still get senior attention.

Most of our clients come to us with a vision for their home remodeling project and the desire to have a different and better experience than the traditional design bid build model that they may have been frustrated with in the past. We develop your design, value engineer it throughout the process, and present a fixed price before construction begins, so you know exactly what you're getting, and exactly what it costs, before we ever break ground. Price certainty, a strong process, and a highly experienced team is what sets us apart.

START THE CONVERSATION
HOW IT WORKS
A thoughtful process, start to finish

A clear, guided path from concept to completion. Design, budget, permitting, and construction are considered together from the beginning, so you always know where you are, what comes next, and how each decision affects the whole project.

Initial Consultation

We start with a conversation about your home, your goals, your vision, and your investment range. We’ll talk through what you’re hoping to accomplish, how our design-build process works, and whether your project feels like the right fit for both of us.

No pressure. Just an honest first conversation and a clear next step.

Design Phase 1

Before diving into design, we take a closer look at the realities of your project—your existing home, priorities, constraints, permitting considerations, and investment range.

We explore what’s possible and begin aligning scope, design ambitions, and budget early, when there is still plenty of room to make thoughtful decisions.

The goal is a shared vision and a realistic path forward before significant design work begins.

Design Phase 2

With a Design Agreement in place, our in-house design team turns that direction into a real project—developing plans, layouts, materials, fixtures, finishes, and the details that make the home yours.

Because the people designing your project are working alongside the people who will ultimately build it, constructability and cost are part of the conversation throughout design—not something we discover at the end.

What we design should be beautiful, buildable, and aligned with the investment you’ve established.

Documents and Permitting

As the design comes together, we develop the technical drawings and specifications needed to build it, coordinate consultants and engineering, and guide the project through permitting.

At the same time, selections and details continue to be documented so the project becomes increasingly defined and trackable.

By the time we move into final pricing, we know what we’re building—not just what we hope to build.

Fixed-Price Contract

Once the scope is fully defined, selections are dialed in, and the project is ready to build, we present a fixed-price construction contract.

We don’t ask you to commit to construction based on a rough estimate and figure out the details later. The work of design, documentation, selections, and pricing happens first.

You’ll know exactly what you’re building—and exactly what it costs—before we break ground.

Construction

When construction begins, the project doesn’t get handed off to a completely different team. Your project manager and site superintendent work from the plans, selections, budget, and decisions developed throughout the design process.

They oversee the schedule, trades, craftsmanship, jobsite, and communication, with regular updates and clear accountability along the way.

One integrated team, carrying the project from the first conversation through the final details of your home.

Our Warranty

Our comprehensive warranty gives you peace of mind that we will be there for you long after your project is completed.

START THE CONVERSATION
WHY DESIGN BUILD?
What the design-build model provides

The advantages of a design-build versus GC and architect are:

From start to finish, you have experienced and trusted advisors advocating for you and your home, and educated in the right ways to make the dream a reality.

We have the unique ability to marry the client’s desires and needs with the budget throughout the entire process. Pricing and financial management are part of what we do with you, that can is front and center, and not kicked down the road after too many design dollars have been spent.

There’s streamlined and consistent communication between designers and the trades who will actually be on your project. We’ve curated relationships with reliable, quality craftspeople, who have been vetted to meet our high standards.

Price Certainty

We work on a fixed price single number construction contract. All selections and every last detail is taken into account when pricing your project so you can go into your build with the confidence that fixed price brings.

A Proven, Predictable Process

Design build is a unique skill set. We geek out on order, communication, and a clear sequence and we're contractors, so we balance that architectural rigor with real-world practicality and a no nonsense approach. Every phase follows a defined path, our designers are tempered with real life constraints and deadlines of a production and estimating team, and we keep you informed at every step.

Budget Alignment Throughout Design

We manage your goals, needs, and budget against the design from day one, value engineering your project throughout the process to keep selections aligned with investment and project goals, and in accordance with the overall vision, without compromising what you came to us for. Our goal is that your investment in design is razor sharp with nothing presented to you that would not be possible in your unique real world application.

One Team, Full Accountability

Your designer works full time directly with your project manager and field team. There's no gap between who designed it and who's building it, and your designer is steeped in our process and our construction driven world.. When a question comes up, one team answers it together, with a hive mind that you just can’t get in a more fractured design bid (hope) build model. We are dreamers grounded in reality, which helps your design and construction dollars go further.

Local Expertise

We've navigated Santa Barbara's unique permitting processes and requirements, Montecito remodeling and overlay regulations, and Hope Ranch project considerations across dozens of projects. That familiarity informs how we approach feasibility and timeline from the very first conversation. Our entire team lives, works and breathes Santa Barbara remodeling, construction and design which is a client advantage and resource.

Clarity Before Commitment

We operate on fixed price contract. We don't ask you to commit to construction until the scope is fully defined, priced and selections are dialed and trackable. You'll know exactly what you're building, and exactly what it costs, before we break ground.

WHAT WE BUILD
Design-build services
Whole House Remodels

Full-scope Santa Barbara home remodeling transformations, from gut renovation to thoughtful updates that make your whole home work the way your life does.

Kitchen Design and Remodel

We design and build kitchens worth cooking in — Santa Barbara kitchen remodeling from concept through construction, with layouts that work, finishes that hold up, and details that feel like they were always there.

Bath Design and Remodel

Santa Barbara bathroom remodeling done right — spa-quality bathrooms designed and built by the same team. We handle layout, plumbing, tile, and every detail that makes the difference between fine and exceptional.

Home Additions

We design and build additions that feel like they've always been part of your home — from the first sketch through permits, construction, and close-out.

What does “design build” mean?

The design + build model delivers a seamless, high-level process by bringing design and construction under one roof. Unlike the traditional architect bid model, where an architect designs and contractors compete to build, design + build fosters early collaboration, value engineering, and budget alignment. This ensures the design matches the budget and schedule, reducing costly surprises and delays.

With a single team handling every phase, communication stays sharp, efficiency stays high, and execution stays on point. Accountability is streamlined, meaning fewer gaps and more precision, quality, and care throughout the project.

While the majority of our clients have us fully manage the design and see the value of Design + Build, we also play well with others!  

Our Iterative Design Process (IDP), also integrate seamlessly with architects and interior designers, fostering a collaborative loop that refines ideas, maintains feasibility, and elevates the end product and client experience. We love partnering with design professionals who share our commitment to financial responsibility, quality and detail.

This approach reflects a commitment to doing things right, the first time. It’s an investment in a smoother, more refined experience, free from the friction of managing multiple parties. The result? A level of predictability that raises the industry’s bar.

Our People
Kiel Kellow

OWNER

Kiel Kellow is an anomaly in the building trade, a design focused builder who believes that estimating and design should always go hand in hand. As the leader of Kellow Construction, Kiel’s approach ensures that all design work is not just creative and beautiful, but practical and aligned with the client’s investment range. This philosophy reduces the typical back and forth between design and construction, making the process more efficient and cohesive.

A highly attuned business owner, Kiel is a naturally calm and effective leader who values ethics, hard work, and communication above all else. He is not your typical builder, he genuinely loves the process of guiding clients through projects that might initially feel overwhelming or out of reach. Helping people accomplish something transformative while balancing design vision with real world practicality is one of his greatest skills.

Kiel grew up in both Tillamook County, Oregon, and Bainbridge Island, Washington. He honed his carpentry skills while living on his 1934 wooden sailboat in the Bainbridge harbor, working on boats, high end custom homes, and in a cabinet shop crafting all things wood. Eventually, he recognized that his passion for client collaboration and project implementation meant starting his own business.

After moving to Portland, Oregon, Kiel became a lead carpenter with an award winning design/build firm specializing in restaurant build outs. There, he mastered the art of integrating complex architectural details into functional spaces, particularly in light commercial projects.

Today, as the owner of Kellow Construction, Kiel brings together design, estimating, and building with a commitment to quality craftsmanship and client satisfaction. His philosophy is simple: build classic structures that endure and create spaces people love. At the heart of it all, Kiel uses his skills to help people bring their dreams to life, combining creativity with practical execution to make the process as rewarding as the final result.

Emily Kellow

OFFICE MANAGER Emily Kellow was born and raised in Santa Barbara and cares deeply about this community. She attended Starr King Parent Child Workshop, Monte Vista Grammar School, La Colina Junior High, and San Marcos High School. Like many locals, she spent her summers on the beach as a Junior Lifeguard, and she still feels grateful every day to live and raise her family in a place with such extraordinary natural beauty and public lands. After graduating from UC Davis in 2007, Emily moved to Portland, Oregon for what she thought would be a short adventure. Instead, she ended up spending more than a decade there building and running her own residential real estate brokerage. Helping people buy, sell, lease, and renovate the amazing older homes of Portland. That experience gave her a deep appreciation for the complexity of construction projects and the importance of clear communication, strong systems, and financial stewardship. Today at Kellow Construction, Emily works mostly behind the scenes making sure the company runs smoothly for clients and the team alike. She oversees accounting, contracts, insurance, payroll, purchasing, and the systems that keep projects organized and moving forward. If something requires patience, persistence, or a very long hold time on the phone, Emily is usually the one handling it. Emily enjoys helping bring a sense of order and calm to complex projects so clients can focus on the exciting parts of building or remodeling their homes. Outside of work, she loves long walks without a destination, beach days with friends and children, podcasts and audiobooks, cultivating peace and positivity, and volunteering at her son’s neighborhood public school.

Jason

PROJECT MANAGER

Born and raised on the Upper East Side of Santa Barbara, and a proud Santa Barbara Don, Jason brings over 15 years of hands-on carpentry experience to his role as PM. He manages scopes, the day to day activity on site, oversees our subcontractors and production team, and often jumps in with tools on to lend a hand wherever needed.

When he's not on the job, Jason enjoys spending time with his wife Ashley, going on long bike rides, and enjoying the company of his many animals, all while living in the town he’s proud to call home.

Rudy

Superintendent

Rudy grew up in Santa Barbara and has been part of the local construction scene since the days when Paseo Nuevo Mall was still Piccadilly Square, he even worked on the project himself. With more than two decades of experience supervising and managing residential remodels, Rudy brings a deep understanding of what it takes to keep projects organized, efficient, and running smoothly. His sharp eye for quality craftsmanship and well run job sites makes him a natural fit for the Kellow Construction team and helps ensure our projects stay on schedule and on budget. At Kellow Construction, Rudy plays a key role in supporting the kind of thoughtful, high quality work our clients expect. Outside of work, he enjoys spending time with his wife, a high school teacher at Dos Pueblos High School, and their daughter. He also plays drums and music at church on Sundays and enjoys making the most of the beautiful hometown he’s proud to call home, Santa Barbara.

Tara
Designer

A San Diego native, she earned her BFA in Interior Architecture from Chico State before making her way to Santa Barbara, a place she now feels incredibly lucky to call home. A natural people person, she believes that great design starts with genuine relationships and enjoys getting to know her clients and the people she works alongside.

At Kellow Construction, she brings a thoughtful and personal approach to design, creating spaces that feel unique to each client while making the experience along the way just as meaningful as the finished result.

Outside of work, she loves spending time with friends, trying new restaurants and foods, traveling, camping in Big Sur, and enjoying everything life along the California coast has to offer.

Our Carpenters

Kellow Construction runs a team of highly skilled carpenters and foremen in the field. Our strict and comprehensive hiring process has proven to be an effective tool at attracting the best people, and repelling those that are not a great fit. We are uncompromising in our hiring process, and make sure that all our team members commit to adhering strictly to our company values with no exceptions. You can be certain that anyone who works for us has “it” and will handle your project with the care, attention, and respect it deserves.

KELLOW CONSTRUCTION · DESIGN-BUILD · SANTA BARBARA, CA
Santa Barbara Home Remodeling and Renovation

Kellow Construction is a licensed general contractor in Santa Barbara, specializing in home renovation and the design-build process. As a design build firm, we’re a full service team for the entire project. We have architectural design, interior design Santa Barbara homeowners trust, planning, permitting, and construction. Our model has proven time and again that there is real power, efficiency, and a overall better client experience in having the designers and the builders all on the same team.

High-Touch, Small-Team Experience on Large Projects: Big enough and experienced to handle complex, high-end projects.

Small enough that homeowners still get senior attention.

Most of our clients come to us with a vision for their home remodeling project and the desire to have a different and better experience than the traditional design bid build model that they may have been frustrated with in the past. We develop your design, value engineer it throughout the process, and present a fixed price before construction begins, so you know exactly what you're getting, and exactly what it costs, before we ever break ground. Price certainty, a strong process, and a highly experienced team is what sets us apart.

START THE CONVERSATION
HOW IT WORKS
A thoughtful process, start to finish

A clear, guided path from concept to completion. Design, budget, permitting, and construction are considered together from the beginning, so you always know where you are, what comes next, and how each decision affects the whole project.

Initial Consultation

We start with a conversation about your home, your goals, your vision, and your investment range. We’ll talk through what you’re hoping to accomplish, how our design-build process works, and whether your project feels like the right fit for both of us.

No pressure. Just an honest first conversation and a clear next step.

Design Phase 1

Before diving into design, we take a closer look at the realities of your project—your existing home, priorities, constraints, permitting considerations, and investment range.

We explore what’s possible and begin aligning scope, design ambitions, and budget early, when there is still plenty of room to make thoughtful decisions.

The goal is a shared vision and a realistic path forward before significant design work begins.

Design Phase 2

With a Design Agreement in place, our in-house design team turns that direction into a real project—developing plans, layouts, materials, fixtures, finishes, and the details that make the home yours.

Because the people designing your project are working alongside the people who will ultimately build it, constructability and cost are part of the conversation throughout design—not something we discover at the end.

What we design should be beautiful, buildable, and aligned with the investment you’ve established.

Documents and Permitting

As the design comes together, we develop the technical drawings and specifications needed to build it, coordinate consultants and engineering, and guide the project through permitting.

At the same time, selections and details continue to be documented so the project becomes increasingly defined and trackable.

By the time we move into final pricing, we know what we’re building—not just what we hope to build.

Fixed-Price Contract

Once the scope is fully defined, selections are dialed in, and the project is ready to build, we present a fixed-price construction contract.

We don’t ask you to commit to construction based on a rough estimate and figure out the details later. The work of design, documentation, selections, and pricing happens first.

You’ll know exactly what you’re building—and exactly what it costs—before we break ground.

Construction

When construction begins, the project doesn’t get handed off to a completely different team. Your project manager and site superintendent work from the plans, selections, budget, and decisions developed throughout the design process.

They oversee the schedule, trades, craftsmanship, jobsite, and communication, with regular updates and clear accountability along the way.

One integrated team, carrying the project from the first conversation through the final details of your home.

Our Warranty

Our comprehensive warranty gives you peace of mind that we will be there for you long after your project is completed.

START THE CONVERSATION
WHY DESIGN BUILD?
What the design-build model provides

The advantages of a design-build versus GC and architect are:

From start to finish, you have experienced and trusted advisors advocating for you and your home, and educated in the right ways to make the dream a reality.

We have the unique ability to marry the client’s desires and needs with the budget throughout the entire process. Pricing and financial management are part of what we do with you, that can is front and center, and not kicked down the road after too many design dollars have been spent.

There’s streamlined and consistent communication between designers and the trades who will actually be on your project. We’ve curated relationships with reliable, quality craftspeople, who have been vetted to meet our high standards.

Price Certainty

We work on a fixed price single number construction contract. All selections and every last detail is taken into account when pricing your project so you can go into your build with the confidence that fixed price brings.

A Proven, Predictable Process

Design build is a unique skill set. We geek out on order, communication, and a clear sequence and we're contractors, so we balance that architectural rigor with real-world practicality and a no nonsense approach. Every phase follows a defined path, our designers are tempered with real life constraints and deadlines of a production and estimating team, and we keep you informed at every step.

Budget Alignment Throughout Design

We manage your goals, needs, and budget against the design from day one, value engineering your project throughout the process to keep selections aligned with investment and project goals, and in accordance with the overall vision, without compromising what you came to us for. Our goal is that your investment in design is razor sharp with nothing presented to you that would not be possible in your unique real world application.

One Team, Full Accountability
